title: STAMP for macOS (Apple Silicon)
description: Native macOS (Apple Silicon) port of STAMP 2.1.3, Statistical Analysis of Metagenomic Profiles (Parks, Tyson, Hugenholtz & Beiko, Bioinformatics 2014, doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btu494). The statistics, plots, windows and menus are upstream STAMP's; only the runtime was ported (Python 3.12, PyQt6), packaged as a Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized .app. Upstream source: https://github.com/donovan-h-parks/STAMP
